theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_energy_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsOpen U → LocallyIntegrableOn H U V.weight → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ tsupport g → V.tangentialGradient g x = 0) ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ ‖V.tangentialGradient g x‖) V.weight ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ g x * ‖H x‖) V.weight
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
